attempts.summary: Built the lan-a/lan-b topology on node1 (OPNsense OPT1=vtnet1=10.60.1.1/24 toward node2, OPT2=vtnet2=10.60.2.1/24 toward node3), addressed node2 (10.60.1.10) and node3 (10.60.2.10) statically via systemd-networkd with static routes across node1, created a single port-type alias 'node3_svc_ports' (8080,8443,9000) on node1, and added one firewall pass rule on the LAN_A (opt1) interface from node2's IP to node3's IP referencing that alias for the destination port. Verified pf expanded the alias into three per-port pass rules, confirmed traffic on all three ports succeeds while an unlisted port (2222) and the reverse direction are blocked by default-deny. Then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on node2, node3, and node1 (OPNsense), proving boot-identity change on each (Linux boot_id, FreeBSD kern.boottime) and re-verifying post-restart that IP/routes, the alias, the pf rules, and actual TCP connectivity to all three ports all recovered.
